name: Reedley
seo_title: Reedley Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 7 Events, 5 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Reedley, California for 2026: 7 family events, 5 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Reedley mixes farm country with a downtown parade of lit farm equipment, and its best known Christmas stop is a tree farm with a steam train.
celebrates: The Reedley Chamber of Commerce runs Christmas in the Park at Pioneer Park, with food trucks, craft booths, train and pony rides, a tree lighting and the Reedley Lions Club's Electrical Farm Equipment Parade on G Street. South of town, Hillcrest Tree Farm sells trees every day and runs the Wahtoke Railroad steam train, Santa photos and food vendors on weekends, then adds Pajama Christmas train nights. Reedley Library offers a visit with Santa, and neighbors Orange Cove and Parlier hold their own parades and tree lightings the same week.
lastyear: Hillcrest Tree Farm's own site lists the Christmas tree season and its steam train, and the Reedley Chamber's Christmas in the Park page describes the annual parade of farm equipment on G Street. For 2025 the chamber scheduled the parade for early December. We did not find a host recap of the 2025 attendance.
facts: The Reedley parade is called the Electrical Farm Equipment Parade because its entries are farm tractors and equipment decorated with lights, and the Reedley Lions Club leads it each year. This year's theme is Christmas Traditions from Around the World. Hillcrest's Pajama Christmas invites guests to wear pajamas to the steam train, and its tree season sells cut your own Monterey pines.
trains: The closest real train ride for families is the Wahtoke Railroad steam train at Hillcrest Tree Farm, 6943 S Reed Ave in Reedley. The farm runs steam train rides and Santa photos on Saturdays and Sundays from November 28 to about December 20, 2026, with train tickets at $5 to $10 for ages 2 and up, plus moonlight Pajama Christmas train nights at $40 per person. We have not found a verified Christmas train event inside town limits.
traditions: A parade of tractors and farm equipment lit up on G Street.
Weekend train rides at Hillcrest Tree Farm during tree season.
Evening steam train rides in pajamas with cookies and hot chocolate.
Reedley, Parlier and Orange Cove each light a tree in the same week.
kidfact: The Reedley parade is made of farm tractors covered in Christmas lights, led by the Reedley Lions Club.
faq: What is the Electrical Farm Equipment Parade in Reedley?

It is the Reedley Lions Club's Christmas parade on G Street between 8th and 14th Streets at 7 pm on Friday, December 4, 2026, after Christmas in the Park begins at Pioneer Park at 5 pm and the tree lights at 6 pm. The chamber says it goes ahead rain or clear skies.
Can kids ride a steam train in Reedley?

Yes. Hillcrest Tree Farm, 6943 S Reed Ave, runs the Wahtoke Railroad steam train on Saturdays and Sundays during its tree season, with train tickets of $5 to $10 for ages 2 and up. Pajama Christmas adds evening rides for $40 per person.

Santa takes photos at Hillcrest Tree Farm on weekends, and the Reedley Branch Library, 1027 E St, lists a Visit with Santa on December 12. Orange Cove Branch Library also lists free pictures with Santa on December 5.
Are there other towns with events on this page?
Yes. Orange Cove and Parlier each have fewer than three verified events, so their parades and Santa pictures are listed here, with Reedley as the nearest larger town.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Reedley for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Hillcrest Tree Farm and Wahtoke Railroad) through December 23 (Pajama Christmas steam train nights), with Christmas in the Park and the Electrical Farm Equipment Parade (December 4), the Parlier Winter Lights Parade (December 2) and Pictures with Santa in Orange Cove (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Reedley

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Reedley, including Parlier and Orange Cove
  • 5 free events, including the Reedley parade, the Parlier parade, the Orange Cove parade and free Santa pictures
  • Meet Santa: at Hillcrest Tree Farm on weekends, at Orange Cove Branch Library (December 5) and at Reedley Library (December 12)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Parlier (December 2), Orange Cove (December 3) and Reedley (December 4)
  • Trains: the Wahtoke Railroad steam train and Pajama Christmas nights at Hillcrest Tree Farm
  • Season: November 28, 2026 to December 23, 2026
